capabilities.title: Shipment Grouping
capabilities.desc: Group multiple individual shipments into a single consolidated load. Reduce per-unit shipping costs and optimize container utilization across routes.

capabilities.title: Container Management
capabilities.desc: Track and manage containers by type, capacity, and assigned voyage. Monitor fill levels and assign shipments to containers with load optimization.

capabilities.title: Pallet Tracking
capabilities.desc: Assign shipments to pallets, track pallet weights, dimensions, and positions within containers. Full visibility from warehouse to port.

capabilities.title: Manifest Generation
capabilities.desc: Create voyage manifests automatically from consolidated shipment data. Print or export manifests for carriers, customs, and port authorities.

capabilities.title: Voyage Management
capabilities.desc: Schedule and manage voyages with vessel details, departure and arrival ports, and estimated transit times. Assign manifests to voyages in one step.

capabilities.title: Load Optimization
capabilities.desc: Maximize container utilization with load planning tools. Visualize how packages fit together by weight and volume before finalizing the load.

capabilities.title: Barcode Scanning
capabilities.desc: Scan package barcodes at receiving and dispatch to verify every item in a consolidation. Reduce manual entry errors and speed up cargo processing.

capabilities.title: Manifest Status Tracking
capabilities.desc: Track manifests through every stage: open, in-progress, submitted, closed. Close and finalize manifests with a single action when the voyage departs.

workflow.title: Receive Shipments
workflow.desc: Incoming shipments are received at the warehouse and scanned into the system. Each package is logged with weight, dimensions, and handling requirements.

workflow.title: Group for Consolidation
workflow.desc: Select shipments heading to the same destination or via the same route. Group them into a consolidation batch for a specific voyage.

workflow.title: Assign to Container
workflow.desc: Assign the consolidated batch to a container or pallet. Load optimization shows available capacity and suggests the most efficient arrangement.

workflow.title: Generate Manifest
workflow.desc: NTIGI auto-produces the voyage manifest with all shipment details, weights, package counts, and customs information ready for the carrier.

workflow.title: Close & Dispatch
workflow.desc: Close the manifest when loading is complete. The voyage status updates, customers are notified, and all records are archived with a full audit trail.

jsx.p_0: Group shipments, manage containers, generate voyage manifests, and track every load from warehouse floor to port departure all in one offline-first system.
jsx.terminal_desc_1: Auto-generated manifest with all shipment, weight & customs data
jsx.terminal_desc_2: Voyage record with vessel, ports, manifests & shipment totals
jsx.p_1: Full consolidation operations in one system from receiving individual packages through to closing the voyage manifest.
jsx.p_2: A clear five-step consolidation process every action tracked, every document generated automatically.
jsx.p_3: From auto-generating a manifest from your consolidation batch to tracking a voyage from port to port all inside one screen.
jsx.p_4: Manifests are generated automatically from the shipments in your consolidation. No manual data entry the system builds the document from the booking record.
jsx.p_5: Each voyage captures the full operational picture vessel, ports, timelines, and all associated manifests and shipments.
jsx.p_6: Consolidate LCL shipments into full containers. Generate Bills of Lading and port manifests directly from NTIGI.
jsx.p_7: Manage goods-in with barcode scanning, assign to consolidation batches by destination, and track every pallet from shelf to dispatch dock.
jsx.p_8: Bundle last-mile courier packages into route-based consolidations for dispatch vehicles. Reduce trips, increase delivery density per run.
jsx.related_desc_0: Manage cross-border shipments, multi-leg routes, and partner agency networks end to end.
jsx.related_desc_1: Auto-generate customs documentation and run compliance screening on every consolidated shipment.
jsx.related_desc_2: Manage shelf locations, stock levels, receiving, and dispatch within your warehouse operations.
jsx.p_9: See how NTIGI manages your consolidation workflow from warehouse receiving to voyage departure in a live walkthrough with our team.

capabilities.title: Pallet Tracking
capabilities.desc: Assign individual packages to pallets with full weight and dimension tracking. Each pallet has its own record showing current load, assigned container, and departure status.

capabilities.title: Container Fill Optimization
capabilities.desc: Visualize available container capacity before finalizing a load. The system shows weight and volume utilization and flags containers that are over or under capacity.

capabilities.title: Load Planning
capabilities.desc: Plan how packages are arranged across pallets and containers. Organize by destination, route, or shipment type to minimize handling time at discharge ports.

capabilities.title: Barcode Scan to Consolidate
capabilities.desc: Warehouse staff scan barcodes at the consolidation station to assign packages to consolidation batches. Each scan is logged with timestamp and operator identity.

capabilities.title: Manifest Workflows
capabilities.desc: Generate voyage manifests automatically from consolidation batch data. Manifests include all package details, weights, dimensions, and customs information for carriers.

capabilities.title: Voyage Assignment
capabilities.desc: Assign consolidation batches to voyages in one step. Track the voyage from manifest creation through departure confirmation and arrival at destination port.

capabilities.title: Warehouse Location Integration
capabilities.desc: Consolidated cargo stays linked to its warehouse shelf and bin location until dispatch. Staff always know where any item is in the warehouse during the consolidation process.

capabilities.title: Hub Performance Reports
capabilities.desc: Monitor consolidation volumes, container fill rates, average dwell time per shipment, and departure schedules. Export reports for operations and management teams.

workflow.title: Receive at Hub
workflow.desc: Incoming shipments arrive at the consolidation hub and are scanned into the system. Each package is assigned a bin location and flagged for its destination consolidation batch.

workflow.title: Sort and Group
workflow.desc: Packages are sorted by destination route and grouped into consolidation batches. The system shows how many packages are ready for each batch and their combined weight.

workflow.title: Assign to Pallets
workflow.desc: Staff scan packages to assign them to pallets. Load optimization tracks remaining capacity and alerts when a pallet reaches its weight or volume limit.

workflow.title: Load into Containers
workflow.desc: Pallets are assigned to containers. The system shows container fill levels and confirms the load is within capacity before the manifest is generated.

workflow.title: Generate and Dispatch
workflow.desc: Manifest is produced automatically. Staff confirm loading is complete and close the manifest. The voyage status updates and the consolidation batch is dispatched.

jsx.p_0: Pallet tracking, load optimization, and container manifest workflows for warehouse consolidation operations. Every package tracked from receiving through to voyage departure in one offline-first system.
jsx.p_1: Every step from receiving shipments at the hub to loading the final container and generating the voyage manifest, tracked and automated.
jsx.h2_1: From Hub Receiving to Voyage Dispatch
jsx.p_2: A clear five-step hub consolidation cycle from the moment freight arrives to when the container departs.
jsx.p_3: Voyage manifests are produced automatically from consolidation batch data. No re-entering information. The manifest pulls directly from the shipment and pallet records.
jsx.p_4: Each pallet in the hub has a complete operational record. Staff can locate, weigh, and dispatch any pallet without guesswork.
jsx.p_5: The consolidation batch view and operations dashboard your warehouse team uses from the hub floor every day.
jsx.caption_0: Consolidation batch view packages grouped by destination and pallet
jsx.caption_1: Hub operations dashboard container fill rates and voyage status
jsx.p_6: Receive LCL cargo from multiple shippers, sort by port of destination, load into FCL containers, and generate Bills of Lading and port manifests in one workflow.
jsx.p_7: Manage high-volume receiving from multiple origins. Sort, palletize, and load outbound containers while tracking every package through barcode scanning at each stage.
jsx.p_8: Consolidate last-mile deliveries from a central hub into route-based loads. Maximize vehicle capacity and reduce the number of runs with load optimization tools.
jsx.related_desc_0: Configure warehouse shelf and bin locations, manage capacity, and run full receiving and dispatch operations that feed into the consolidation hub.
jsx.related_desc_1: Track every package at item level with barcode scanning and real-time stock updates that integrate directly with consolidation batch assignments.
jsx.related_desc_2: Generate customs documentation for consolidated shipments and run compliance screening before the manifest is submitted to port authorities.
jsx.p_9: See how NTIGI handles pallet tracking, load optimization, and manifest generation for your consolidation hub in a live walkthrough with our team.

capabilities.title: Self-Service Shipment Booking
capabilities.desc: Customers book shipments directly through the portal without calling an agent. Select route, package type, service level, and confirm pricing before submitting.

capabilities.title: Real-Time Shipment Tracking
capabilities.desc: Every customer can track their own shipments live. Status updates from picked up through to delivered, with GPS-backed location data at each stage.

capabilities.title: Invoice Downloads
capabilities.desc: Customers access and download PDF invoices for all their shipments directly from the portal. No need to contact an agent for billing documents.

capabilities.title: Payment History
capabilities.desc: Full payment history is visible to each customer: every payment made, every outstanding balance, and every invoice status in one place.

capabilities.title: Profile Management
capabilities.desc: Customers update their own contact details, addresses, and notification preferences without staff involvement. Changes are reflected across all their shipments instantly.

capabilities.title: Automated Notifications
capabilities.desc: Customers receive automatic SMS, email, push, and WhatsApp notifications at every shipment milestone. Configured by the customer, not by your agents.

capabilities.title: Public Tracking Portal
capabilities.desc: Any shipment can be tracked publicly by entering the tracking number. No login required. Share the tracking link with anyone who needs visibility on a shipment.

capabilities.title: Mobile App Access
capabilities.desc: The full customer portal is accessible as a mobile PWA. Customers install it once from their browser and access it like a native app on any device.

workflow.title: Customer Registers
workflow.desc: Customers register or are created in the system by your agents. They receive login credentials and access their personalized portal immediately.

workflow.title: Books a Shipment
workflow.desc: The customer selects route, package details, and service level. Pricing is calculated automatically from your configured rate cards. No agent needed.

workflow.title: Receives Confirmation
workflow.desc: A booking confirmation is sent automatically via email and SMS with the tracking number, cost summary, and estimated delivery window.

workflow.title: Tracks in Real Time
workflow.desc: The customer follows their shipment through the portal or public tracking link. Each status update triggers an automatic notification to their preferred channel.

workflow.title: Downloads Invoice
workflow.desc: Once delivered, the customer downloads their PDF invoice from the portal. Outstanding balances and payment history are always visible in their account.

jsx.p_0: Give every client their own self-service portal. Book shipments, track deliveries in real time, download invoices, and manage their profile from any device. No agent calls required.
jsx.h2_0: Everything Customers Need Without Calling You
jsx.p_1: The customer portal handles every common client request automatically, reducing support calls and improving the customer experience.
jsx.p_2: The complete customer journey from first login to delivery confirmation, without a single agent interaction needed.
jsx.p_3: Every client gets a secure, personalized portal showing only their own shipments, invoices, and payment history.
jsx.p_4: Every shipment event triggers an automatic notification via the customer's preferred channel. No manual sending by your staff.
jsx.p_5: Customers access the full portal from any smartphone without downloading an app. Open the browser, log in, and add to home screen. Available on iOS and Android. Works even with intermittent connectivity.
jsx.p_5_desc: Supports English, French, Chinese, and German out of the box with more languages ready to add.
jsx.p_6: Give your online shoppers the tracking experience they expect. Real-time notifications, delivery photos, and a clean tracking page branded to your logistics operation.
jsx.p_7: Business clients who ship daily can manage their own bookings, monitor outstanding balances, and download invoices for accounting without needing your staff.
jsx.p_8: Customers submit return shipment requests through the portal. Your team reviews and approves. The return is created, tracked, and invoiced automatically.
jsx.related_desc_0: Signature capture and photo confirmation sent directly to the customer via the portal after every delivery.
jsx.related_desc_1: Invoices generated at booking are immediately available for customer download in the portal.

capabilities.title: Commercial Invoice Generation
capabilities.desc: Auto-generate compliant commercial invoices for every international shipment. Pre-filled with shipper, receiver, commodity details, HS codes, and declared values.

capabilities.title: Packing List & Certificate of Origin
capabilities.desc: Produce packing lists and certificates of origin directly from shipment data. No re-entering information, documents pull from the booking record.

capabilities.title: HS Code Management
capabilities.desc: Search and assign Harmonized System codes to packages. System validates codes and calculates applicable duties and taxes per destination country.

capabilities.title: Duty & Tax Calculation
capabilities.desc: Automatically compute customs duties, VAT, and applicable import taxes based on HS codes, declared values, and destination regulations.

capabilities.title: Dangerous Goods Handling
capabilities.desc: Flag and classify dangerous goods per IATA and IMDG regulations. Ensure correct documentation and handling instructions are attached to every relevant shipment.

capabilities.title: Sanction List Screening
capabilities.desc: Screen senders and receivers against international sanctions lists before shipment processing. Block or flag restricted entities automatically.

capabilities.title: Export / Import Restriction Checks
capabilities.desc: Validate every shipment against country-level export and import restriction databases. Catch prohibited items before they reach the border.

capabilities.title: Audit Trail & Compliance Logs
capabilities.desc: Every document generated, status changed, and decision made is logged with user, timestamp, and reason, providing a complete exportable compliance audit trail.

workflow.title: Create Shipment
workflow.desc: Enter package details, sender, receiver, and commodity information. System prompts for HS codes and declared value at the point of booking.

workflow.title: Auto Compliance Check
workflow.desc: System screens against sanctions lists and restriction databases in real time. Flagged shipments are held for review before processing continues.

workflow.title: Generate Documents
workflow.desc: One click produces commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, and customs declaration form, all pre-populated and formatted for submission.

workflow.title: Calculate Duties
workflow.desc: Duties, VAT, and import taxes are computed using HS codes and destination country rules. Totals appear on the invoice and can be passed to the client.

workflow.title: Submit & Archive
workflow.desc: Submit documentation to customs authorities. All records are archived with full audit trail, searchable, exportable, and retained per your data policy.

jsx.p_0: Automate customs documentation, HS code management, duty calculations, and regulatory compliance checks, all built directly into the NTIGI shipment workflow.
jsx.p_1: Every compliance requirement handled automatically, from document generation to regulatory screening, before the shipment moves.
jsx.p_2: Compliance is embedded in the shipment workflow, not a separate step that slows you down.
jsx.p_3: All required customs documents are produced directly from the shipment record, no separate system, no re-entry of data.
jsx.p_4: Every shipment runs through a full compliance screening stack before processing, automatically, without manual intervention.
jsx.p_5: All compliance data is protected with AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. Role-based access control ensures only authorized staff can view or modify sensitive customs records.
jsx.p_5_desc: Complete audit trail with user, timestamp, and action recorded on every document change.
jsx.p_6: Live compliance screening at booking and auto-generated customs documents all inside the same screen.
jsx.terminal_desc_1: Real-time sanctions and restriction screening at point of booking
jsx.terminal_desc_2: Commercial invoice, packing list & certificate generated in one click
jsx.p_7: Handle multiple client accounts with document generation, HS code lookup, and duty calculation built in. Reduce manual paperwork and clearance time.
jsx.p_8: Embed compliance directly into your international forwarding workflow. Documents are generated at the point of booking, not as an afterthought.
jsx.p_9: Full audit trail, exportable compliance logs, and screening records for every shipment. Built-in GDPR tools and configurable data retention policies.
jsx.related_desc_0: Manage cross-border shipments, multi-leg routes, and partner agency networks end to end.
jsx.related_desc_1: Group shipments into voyages, manage containers, and generate manifests for customs submission.
jsx.related_desc_2: Issue multi-currency invoices with duties and taxes automatically calculated per jurisdiction.
jsx.p_10: See how NTIGI handles documentation, screening, and duty calculations for your specific trade lanes in a live walkthrough with our team.

capabilities.title: Bulk Shipment Creation
capabilities.desc: Process hundreds of orders in one operation. Create shipments individually or import in bulk. Each order gets its own tracking number, label, and receipt automatically.

capabilities.title: Real-Time Order Tracking
capabilities.desc: Every online shopper can track their order in real time via the public tracking portal or customer portal. No login required for the public tracking page.

capabilities.title: Automated Customer Notifications
capabilities.desc: Shoppers receive automatic SMS, email, push, and WhatsApp notifications at every delivery milestone. Configured once by your operations team, runs automatically.

capabilities.title: REST API for Store Integration
capabilities.desc: Connect your online store directly to NTIGI via the REST API. Orders placed on your platform trigger shipment creation in NTIGI automatically without manual entry.

capabilities.title: Returns Management
capabilities.desc: Customers initiate returns through the portal. Return labels are generated automatically. Every return is tracked, photographed, and reconciled against the original order.

capabilities.title: COD Management
capabilities.desc: Track cash on delivery collections per driver across every route. Automatic reconciliation when orders are delivered and paid. Full COD reporting per client and per run.

capabilities.title: Automatic Invoice Generation
capabilities.desc: Invoices are created the moment a shipment is booked. PDF generation, email delivery, and download access for customers in the portal from day one.

capabilities.title: Barcode and Label Printing
capabilities.desc: Generate and print shipping labels with barcodes and QR codes for every order. Batch print entire dispatch runs. Scan labels at pickup and delivery.

workflow.title: Order Received
workflow.desc: Your online store sends order data to NTIGI via the REST API or your agent creates shipments manually. Each order is processed into a shipment record instantly.

workflow.title: Label Printed
workflow.desc: A shipping label with barcode is generated and printed. The customer receives an order confirmation with tracking number via SMS and email automatically.

workflow.title: Dispatched and Tracked
workflow.desc: The package is assigned to a driver and route. The customer can track live. Automated notifications fire at each status update without any manual intervention.

workflow.title: Delivered and Confirmed
workflow.desc: Driver captures signature and delivery photo. Delivery confirmation is sent to the customer. COD payment is recorded if applicable. Invoice is closed.

workflow.title: Returns Processed
workflow.desc: If a return is requested, the customer gets a label automatically. The return is tracked back to your warehouse and a credit note or refund is issued.

apiCapabilities: Status update callbacks to your store

capabilities.title: Multi-Method Payments
capabilities.desc: Accept cash, credit and debit cards, bank transfers, mobile money (MTN, Orange, Airtel), and COD collections. All payment types tracked in one place.

capabilities.title: Automatic Invoice Generation
capabilities.desc: Invoices are created instantly when a shipment is booked. Custom templates, automatic numbering, tax calculations, and PDF generation built in.

capabilities.title: Multi-Currency Support
capabilities.desc: Issue invoices and process payments in multiple currencies. Currency conversion is handled automatically with configurable exchange rates per route.

capabilities.title: COD & Split Payments
capabilities.desc: Track cash on delivery collections across drivers and branches. Allow clients to pay using split payment methods across a single shipment.

capabilities.title: Revenue & P&L Reports
capabilities.desc: View revenue by branch, route, or agent. Generate profit and loss statements with custom date ranges and export to Excel or PDF instantly.

capabilities.title: Agent Commission Tracking
capabilities.desc: Calculate and track agent commissions automatically based on configurable structures. View individual agent performance and commission breakdowns.

capabilities.title: Outstanding Balances
capabilities.desc: Track client outstanding balances in real time. Set credit limits, configure credit terms, and send automated payment reminders via email or SMS.

capabilities.title: Refund Management
capabilities.desc: Process refunds and payment reversals against original invoices. Every refund is logged with reason, user, and timestamp for full audit trail.

workflow.title: Shipment Booked
workflow.desc: When a shipment is created, the system calculates the charge based on route pricing, weight, service level, and any applicable surcharges.

workflow.title: Invoice Generated
workflow.desc: An invoice is automatically created with all shipment details, taxes, and totals. It is emailed to the client and available for PDF download.

workflow.title: Payment Collected
workflow.desc: Payment is recorded against the invoice: cash, card, mobile money, or bank transfer. Receipt is printed or emailed to the client immediately.

workflow.title: COD Tracked
workflow.desc: For COD shipments, collection is tracked per driver. Once delivered and collected, the payment is reconciled against the shipment record.

workflow.title: Reports Generated
workflow.desc: At any time, generate revenue reports, commission statements, and branch performance comparisons. Export to Excel, PDF, or CSV.

accountingIntegrations.name: Xero

accountingIntegrations.name: Custom Export
accountingIntegrations.desc: Export any financial data to Excel, CSV, or PDF for use in any accounting tool.

vehicleCapabilities.title: Vehicle Registration
vehicleCapabilities.desc: Register every vehicle in your fleet with type, capacity, license plate, registration number, and assigned branch. Full vehicle record accessible at any time.

vehicleCapabilities.title: Capacity Tracking
vehicleCapabilities.desc: Track the load capacity of each vehicle by weight and volume. Prevent over-loading by monitoring what is assigned versus what the vehicle can carry on each run.

vehicleCapabilities.title: Maintenance Scheduling
vehicleCapabilities.desc: Schedule and track vehicle maintenance by mileage or date. Receive alerts before service is due. Keep a complete maintenance history per vehicle.

vehicleCapabilities.title: Fuel Tracking
vehicleCapabilities.desc: Log fuel fill-ups per vehicle and track fuel costs over time. Monitor fuel consumption per route to identify inefficiencies and reduce operating costs.

vehicleCapabilities.title: GPS Tracking Integration
vehicleCapabilities.desc: Track every vehicle's live location on an interactive map. Managers see the full fleet in real time. Customers see their shipment moving toward them.

vehicleCapabilities.title: Performance Metrics
